decisions.reason: The co-stated NCA/NH and Site 286R dates are already fully represented by the candidate's message-24 MODIFY; the allocated-budget changes require no additional date update.
The source changes allocated budgets and dates but provides no service weekdays or session time slots for NCA/NH or Site 286R.
The source does not change signature requirements, signature placement, or the sites to which those signature instructions apply.
Changing allocated budget amounts does not necessarily alter the session-based personnel formula, session count, per-session charge, or personnel total.
The independently co-stated correction to seven weeks is already represented by the candidate's message-24 INTRODUCE; the allocated-budget changes require no further weeks-served update.
